title: A witnessed multiplicative inverse cancels on the constructed complex numbers
statement: For a constructed complex number x0 with a positivity witness x2 that its squared norm is bounded away from 0 at precision x1, the inverse Complex.inv(x0, x1, x2) times x0 is Complex.Equiv-equivalent to 1.

formal.statement: theorem Complex.inv_mul_cancel : ((x0 : Complex) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : CReal.PosBound (Complex.normSq x0) x1) -> Complex.Equiv (Complex.mul (Complex.inv x0 x1 x2) x0) Complex.one)))

evidence.supports: Complex.inv_mul_cancel is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
